section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion section describes a single study examining the relationship between body appreciation (measured with a leading scale) and body image flexibility as positive body image constructs in a pre-college sample of Black older-adolescent females. The analysis evaluated whether BMI moderated the associations between these positive body image measures and culturally-relevant indices of body dissatisfaction, drawing from a cognitive-behavioral affect regulation framework.
